title: Server-Sent Events with Node.js and Express
title_es: Server-Sent Events con Node.js y Express
description: Runnable companion for the SSE with Node.js and Express recipe. Includes an Express server, browser client demo, heartbeats, reconnection, and backpressure handling.
description_es: Companion ejecutable para la receta de SSE con Node.js y Express. Incluye un servidor Express, demo de cliente en browser, heartbeats, reconexión y manejo de backpressure.
